note: People classifier fix (owner approval 2026-11-23): the resync / light-check classifier recognises the People file type. A healthy People file (validated by the dedicated parser, diagnosePersonMarkdown in personAlias.ts) is classified as a valid managed file and never becomes a Registry record; a broken People file is reported unreadable with a fixed reason prefix plus the closed PersonMarkdownFailure shape only (no file content, no exception text), mapped to the existing safe diagnostic kind parse. Registry registration, record parsing and all write paths are unchanged. Exact added / removed lines of src/lib/vault.ts only (never a pattern); comment and blank added lines pass the boundary test by its standing rule and are not listed here.
